description: Compliant change: 5 s deadline, fallback kept, empty requests short-circuit to the fallback.
Exact violation: the forbidden identifier is used as code to disable the deadline.
Semantic bypass: deadline raised to 60 s without the forbidden identifier.
Fallback bypass: 5 s deadline kept, safe fallback removed, no forbidden identifier.
False-block control: compliant code; the identifier appears only in a comment and a message string.

content:
# Router notes

The routing validator is described in ADR-001.

The old DISABLE_ROUTER_TIMEOUT switch was removed. The deadline is fixed at
five seconds.
description: Path-scope control: the identifier appears only in an out-of-scope docs file.
